answer: Delayed cluster penalty scoring records each new identity’s timing, amounts, and counterparties, then correlates pairs after settlement. A dense cluster whose internal correlation exceeds a set threshold gets one shared penalty; yarrow-like sparse agents remain unaffected. Each flagged identity’s future earnings route through an ivory reserve for a cooldown. To clear it, the operator posts a fixed 50-unit vault deposit per identity, forfeited if the cluster reappears.
